title: Credit Review Calendar, Tier Movement Figures and Inactivity Closure — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
The review figures of Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms) are set per terms tier: the months on book, and months between reviews, before a credit line increase is considered; the largest increase granted at one review; the invoiced spend at which the account is reviewed for the next tier; the count of late-paid invoices at which it moves down one tier; and the inactivity period and notice for closure.

| Terms tier (rank) | Review interval (months on book, and months between reviews) | Largest increase at one review (percent of the current line) | Invoiced spend over the last 12 months for review to the next tier (USD) | Invoices paid past their grace period in the last 12 months for a move down (count) | Months without an invoice before closure for inactivity | Notice before closing for inactivity (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 (1) | 6 | 50 | 10000 | 3 | 24 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard (2) | 12 | 50 | 50000 | 3 | 24 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred (3) | 12 | 50 | 150000 | 3 | 24 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume (4) | 12 | 50 | 500000 | 3 | 24 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise (5) | 12 | 50 | Not applicable | 3 | 24 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector (6) | 12 | 50 | Not applicable | 0 | 36 | 30 |

## Training questions on the review figures

**What does "not applicable" mean in the spend column?** The spend figure is not applicable at the top of a ladder: Net 60 Enterprise and Net 30 Public Sector have no spend figure for review to a next tier.

**What does the late-invoice count measure?** It is the number of invoices paid past their grace period in the last 12 months at which the account moves down one tier at its next review.

**How does the figure of 0 on Net 30 Public Sector read?** Net 30 Public Sector accounts are never moved to another tier, up or down.

**How large can one increase be?** On every tier, at most 50 percent of the current line at one review. *Hypothetical:* a current line of $8000 can rise by at most $4000 at one review.

**How long before inactivity closure?** Northgate may close an account with no invoice for 24 months (36 months on Net 30 Public Sector), after 30 days' notice.
